newsitem.title: DENMARK: Icopal likely to sell Rieber Phoenix stock.
newsitem.headline: Icopal likely to sell Rieber Phoenix stock.

text.p: Denmark's Icopal said on Thursday it was "very likely" that it would sell off its shares in Danish roadbuilder Phoenix to Norway's Rieber & Son.
Icopal's shareholding in Phoenix was last recorded at 11.23 percent of equity.
"It is very likely that we will now sell (our Phoenix shareholding)," Icopal financial director Asger Laursen told Reuters.
"It is not in our interest to hold shares in a competitor over whom we have no decisive influence," he said.
He was responding to Rieber's announcement that it had over 50 percent of equity and votes in Phoenix, a level at which it said earlier it would implement a takeover of the company.

Rieber and rival suitor Icopal ICOL.CO have each offered 876 million Danish crowns for Phoenix, comprising 790 crowns per A-share and 710 crowns for the most-traded C-share, its market on Thursday afternoon.
